args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.2.9
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate was 0.18 across us-east, us-west, and eu-west). Actions taken: (1) Attempted rollback to v2.3.0, the most recent production release that was healthy. The rollback was rejected because v2.3.0 is quarantined for CVE-2026-4417, so nothing was executed. (2) Rolled back to v2.2.9, the most recent production release before v2.3.1 that is not quarantined. The rollout is verified in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Current state: healthy, error rate 0.002. Follow-up needed: v2.3.0 is quarantined, so the team should decide on a fixed build for CVE-2026-4417 and review why v2.3.1 was deployed and failed health checks.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.2.9 in all three regions and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release, but it is quarantined for CVE-2026-4417. The rollback to it was rejected and nothing ran.
- **What ran:** I rolled back to v2.2.9, the next most recent healthy production release. It is now live in us-east, us-west and eu-west.
- **Current state:** healthy, with error rate down from 0.18 to 0.002.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failing v2.3.1 deploy, the quarantine block on v2.3.0, and the rollback to v2.2.9.

v2.2.9 was not an exact match for the request, which was for the most recent healthy release. I picked it because it is the next healthy production release and is not quarantined. The team should confirm that's acceptable.

Follow-up for the on-call team:
- v2.3.0 is quarantined, so there is no fixed build of the v2.3.0 line yet. Someone needs to decide on a patched build for CVE-2026-4417.
- Someone should also look into why v2.3.1 was deployed and failed health checks.

content.text: The most recent production release that was healthy is v2.3.0 (seq 1). v2.3.1 is the unhealthy release now running in all three regions. Rolling back to v2.3.0, which has a healthy production history, so no change-manager approval is needed.
v2.3.0 is quarantined for CVE-2026-4417, so the rollback was rejected and nothing ran. The next most recent production release that was healthy is v2.2.9, so I'll try that.
